blocks.html: It’s going to be a fun-filled day for pets and pet owners at Robinsons Novaliches as it celebrates the launch of its Happy Pets Club with a great deal of activities from July 2 to 3, all happening at the Trade Hall. Makeover Seminar and Pet Blessing Start the month right by learning a new skill – pet grooming. Robinsons Novaliches’ Happy Pets Club will be giving a free Pet Makeover Seminar on July 2, 2pm which will teach first-time pet owners and aspiring dog groomers the basics, tips and techniques in grooming pets at home. Plus, come with your most-loved animals to the special pet blessing to be celebrated on July 2, 4 pm. Pooch Pampering Give your furry friend the best pampering it deserves. Bring them to the event’s mobile pet grooming station and give them that new cut and refreshing bath at 20% off courtesy of Saint Roch Pet Grooming and VMC Pet Grooming & Pet Shop. Complement their new look with cute outfits, accessories, and pet supplies and products at amazing discounts from Aquatica Trading, Doggies’ Choice, Bow Wow, Pampered Pooch, Play Pets, and Vetmoto. Make this quality time with your best friends memorable by taking a photo with them and using the hashtags #teamdog or #teamcat at the interactive booths and photo corners located within the Trade Hall. Be sure to avail of these exciting deals on July 2-3 between 11 am – 5pm. Health Check A healthy dog is a happy dog. Schedule a free Pet Check-up from July 2 to 3 between 2 pm -5pm at the Trade Hall and be informed about proper pet care. Pet Fashion Show Capping off the exciting 2-day launch will be a Pet Fashion Show where dogs and cats, accompanied by their owners, shall parade the stage and show off their most creative costumes to win fabulous prizes. The contest is open to small to medium sized cats and dogs with approximately 25-50 lbs. in weight or 18 to 25 inches in height. The pet to get the highest point in overall look and cuteness; uniqueness and craftsmanship; stage presence; and audience impact will win P2,000.00 Robinsons GCs and gift packs. Registration is on July 3 from 10am to 4pm. Join the Happy Pets Club Robinsons Malls opens its doors to our beloved 4 legged friends as it brings Happy Pets Club to Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Novaliches this year. Pet parents can now conveniently bring in their pets to the mall by just presenting their Happy Pet’s Club card upon entry. This saves time of having to secure a pet pass, which is only valid for a day, every time pet owners visit the mall. Happy Pets Club members are also entitled to exclusive freebies and discounts on pet care products and services from partner merchants; and the privilege of participating in different Robinsons Malls events and activities for pets. To be part of Robinsons Novaliches’ Happy Pets Club, simply get the application form at the information booth located at Level 1, Expansion Building. Fill out the application form and submit all necessary documents such as copy of the updated rabies vaccination record and two copies of 1x1 picture of your pet in exchange of the free Happy Pets Club card. To know more about Happy Pets Club, follow Robinsons Mall Robinsons Malls in Facebook: www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls; Twitter:@RobinsonsMalls; and Instagram: @RobinsonsMallsOfficial.
